name: Gin'iro, Haruka
source:
Snow is not an uncommon sight in April in one of the northernmost towns of the country. Yukito is a well-known honor student at the local school, unable to leave those alone that need his help. As a second year student the new spring will bring him new feelings in his teenage life. Feelings that will soon turn into beautiful realisation.

In this game there are five heroines, first there’s the transfer student from Canada, Bethly. She loves to paint but only knew the very basics of Japanese before she came to Japan. Next up there’s Hinata, a junior at school who also can’t leave someone alone when they need help. Momiji is Yukito’s classmate and sits next to him in class. She wants to make it onto the big stage of theater plays.

Also aiming for the top is figure skater Mizuha, Yukito’s childhood friend. He gets to meet her again after 2 years abroad. Last of the heroines is his step sister Yuzuki, who somehow feels far away. But maybe that’s because it’s only been one year since she and her mother moved in with them.

From here the story will only have one goal. After so many years, Yukito’s life will take a big turn in just 3 seasons. This is a story of love–

[Edited from [url=http://www.otakulair.com/games/giniro-haruka/]Otaku Lair[/url]]
translation:
在该国最北端的城镇之一，四月下雪并不罕见。幸人是当地学校著名的优等生，他无法放过那些需要他帮助的人。作为二年级学生，新的春天将给他的青少年生活带来新的感受。感情很快就会变成美丽的实现。

游戏中有五个女主角，首先是来自加拿大的转学生贝丝莉。她喜欢画画，但在来日本之前只懂得最基本的日语。接下来是日向，一名三年级学生，当有人需要帮助时，她也不能让他们独自一人。红叶是由纪人的同学，在课堂上坐在他旁边。她想登上戏剧的大舞台。

同样以登顶为目标的还有花样滑冰运动员水羽，他是雪人的儿时好友。出国两年后，他再次见到她。最后一位女主角是他的继妹柚月，她不知何故感觉很遥远。但也许那是因为她和她母亲搬来和他们一起住才一年。

从这里开始，故事将只有一个目标。这么多年过去了，短短三季，雪人的人生就发生了巨大的转变。这是一个关于爱情的故事——

[编辑自[url=http://www.otakulair.com/games/giniro-haruka/]宅男巢穴[/url]]
